hook: AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to organize my week. I needed 3 bullets.
caption:
AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to organize my week. I needed 3 bullets.

Here's what nobody tells you about AI productivity advice:

It doesn't know if you're a "give me the full system" person or a "just tell me what to do right now" person.

So it guesses. And it almost always guesses wrong in the same direction — too much, too structured, too formal.

Because the model is trying to look thorough. Thoroughness feels safe. But for half of us, thoroughness is just noise.

The fix isn't reprompting with "make it shorter."

The fix is the AI knowing — before you even ask — that you think in quick wins, not frameworks. That you want the answer, not the explanation. That a 5-point preamble makes you close the tab.

That's the difference between AI that responds to your words and AI that responds to *you*.

Your bootfile captures exactly this. Not just your job or your goals — your cognitive style. How much context you need. How you make decisions. What kind of output actually lands.

Once it knows that? You stop getting the 47-step plan.
